newsitem.title: USA: Gunman arrested trying to enter Pentagon.
newsitem.headline: Gunman arrested trying to enter Pentagon.

text.p: A lone gunman brandishing a loaded 9 mm Beretta pistol tried to barge through the front door of the Pentagon on Tuesday before being wrestled to the ground and taken into custody, officials said.
A Defence Department spokesman said the suspect made a statement to the Defence Protective Service officer at the building's Mall entrance and then pointed the gun at him.
"The police officer was able to wrestle him to the ground," said Susan Hansen, a Pentagon spokeswoman. She was unable to confirm reports the man had demanded to see an admiral.
No one was injured in the incident, which occurred at about 8:15 a.m. EDT (1215 GMT). Hansen said she understood the gunman was a white male who appeared to be in his mid- to late-20s.

Building security officers cordoned off some parking areas outside the main entrance while they searched a rented red Chevrolet in which the suspect had driven to the headquarters of the Defence Department in Arlington, Va.

Hansen said officers had determined the rental car did not contain any explosives. The suspect was not immediately identified. He was held in a room on the first floor of the Pentagon before being taken to nearby Alexandria, Virginia, for arraignment on unspecified charges.
